unproject_depth_to_xyz: unproject a batch of posed RGBD depth images to 3D XYZ coordinates using camera intrinsics and poses
create_UnprojectRGBDFeatureSLAM: create an UnprojectRGBDFeatureSLAM instance with configurable min and max depth thresholds and a feature generator
add_image_to_voxel_map: add a single RGB image with depth, pose, and intrinsics to a voxelized point cloud map
add_batch_images_to_voxel_map: add a batch of RGB images with depth, pose, and intrinsics to a voxelized point cloud map
clear_UnprojectRGBDFeatureSLAM: clear and reset the UnprojectRGBDFeatureSLAM instance point cloud state
